## Installation

Build the verified repository revision from source:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/aspose-font-foss/Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python.git
cd Aspose.Font-FOSS-for-Python
git checkout 6c7ddfd801d2e2dfea35d1ca2b7e80134616d778
mvn clean install
```

This path requires JDK unknown+ and Maven. The source build and the minimal example
below were verified together at revision `6c7ddfd801d2e2dfea35d1ca2b7e80134616d778`.
